options.text: A single management system can address more than one discipline, so the AI elements can sit inside the existing arrangement.
Rules on competence and impartiality for the auditing body are set out in ISO/IEC 42001 itself, alongside the organization's own requirements.
Each further discipline needs a parallel management system of its own, kept separate from the arrangement already in place.
Where the organization forms part of a larger entity, its management system has to extend across that whole entity.
